high_level_description: This image is a promotional advertisement for a creativity retreat organized by Creativegarh. The design is vibrant with a yellow background and black text, creating a bold and eye-catching contrast. Main Title: "A Creativity Retreat for those who keep pushing things out. Also for those looking for that little push." This suggests the retreat is aimed at individuals who struggle with procrastination or need motivation to continue their creative projects. Event Details: Kasauli: 25-31 October Nainital: 5-11 December
